notes: Livelier reactions. The rules for how strongly people react contradicted each other: one said mild teasing gets mild reactions, a joke gets a chuckle at most and big reactions are rare, while another said nobody is ever flat. Now everyone reacts at their own volume: loud, playful and teasing characters react big and often (a teaser teases constantly), and quiet ones answer in their own smaller way instead of not reacting at all

The live feed sounds like the characters. Off-screen moments only gave the AI each character's short summary; now they also get how that character talks and a few sample lines, so background scenes keep their voice
Texts keep their personality. Longer character sheets were cut off for texting, so characters like Nangong lost their texting quirks ("You miss me?"); texts now get the whole sheet

Sunna only stutters when she's embarrassed, flustered or put on the spot; when she's comfortable, with Nangong and Aria, talking music or arguing, she talks fast and clearly. Teased about something embarrassing, she goes teary-eyed and her voice shakes, but it's playful and over in a moment, never real sobbing
